research_source.scope: Only files tracked at the pinned commit were reviewed. Untracked material was excluded.

verification_state.reproduced: The audit independently recalculated the stated descriptive result from committed source data.
verification_state.source-reported: The result is stated by a committed dataset or report source and was checked for internal consistency without recomputing raw records.
verification_state.paper-reported: The method and result were checked in the paper, but the audit did not rerun the experiment.
verification_state.not-reproducible: The evidence is conceptual, relies on unavailable proprietary inputs, or has insufficient method or provenance for independent reproduction.

claim_class.causal: A randomized or quasi-experimental design is used to estimate an intervention effect.
claim_class.benchmark: A fixed task, corpus, simulator, or evaluation harness is used for comparison.
claim_class.observational-correlation: Associations are measured without intervention assignment.
claim_class.mechanism: The work describes or tests a process that may explain retrieval, citation, ranking, or evaluation behavior.
claim_class.governance: The work addresses policy, safety, provenance, evaluation, or operational controls.
claim_class.null-result: A tested intervention or relationship is absent, weak, inconsistent, or negative in a reported condition.

disposition.retain-guardrail: Supports an existing boundary or evidence control.
disposition.candidate-guidance: May inform future guidance after confirmation and explicit product review.
disposition.boundary-only: Relevant context that does not justify an active GEO tactic.
disposition.exclude-effect-claim: Must not be used as product effectiveness evidence.

paper_title_fields.title: Formal title printed in the pinned PDF, normalized only for spacing and ASCII hyphens.
paper_title_fields.catalog_title: Catalog alias copied exactly from the pinned geo-assessment source map.

surface_summary.evidence_judgment: Routing and contract behavior only; no research-backed outcome claim is made.
Query diversity and repeated sampling have benchmark support; the four task forms remain deterministic heuristics.
surface_summary.action: Label opportunity output as a planning heuristic and keep volume, rank, and conversion out of scope.

surface_summary.evidence_judgment: Structural and brand signals are observational or benchmark proxies.
surface_summary.action: Keep observed, provided, inferred, and input-gap labels; never present readiness scores as effectiveness.

surface_summary.evidence_judgment: The seven-mode content generator has no aggregate effect estimate; research supports evidence fidelity, semantic preservation, explicit uncertainty, and safety as governance requirements.
surface_summary.action: Keep all mode outputs bounded to evidence-backed drafting and free of citation, ranking, traffic, or conversion promises.

surface_summary.evidence_judgment: Clear framing can aid retrieval tasks, while broad visibility lift is unvalidated.
surface_summary.action: Retain claim-safe title drafting without rank promises.

surface_summary.evidence_judgment: Semantic relevance is repeatedly associated with selection and citation, with confounding still present.
surface_summary.action: Use evidence-linked explanations and treat format choices as hypotheses.

surface_summary.evidence_judgment: No reviewed source establishes an effect for the comparison mode. P13 and P42 constrain effect extrapolation, while P25 supports conflict and evidence governance only.
surface_summary.action: Treat consistent criteria, transparent methods, and the prohibition on unsupported winners as governance rules.

surface_summary.evidence_judgment: Ranking tasks expose manipulation and retrieval-stage risks.
surface_summary.action: Keep method transparency, evidence traceability, and safety warnings mandatory.

surface_summary.evidence_judgment: Structure can affect benchmark retrieval, but live platform effects are unstable and platform-specific.
surface_summary.action: Present page structure as a testable blueprint.

surface_summary.evidence_judgment: Many rewriting benchmarks show tradeoffs, degradation, or small gains.
surface_summary.action: Prioritize semantic preservation, factual fidelity, and reversible edits.

surface_summary.evidence_judgment: Publication formatting is operationally useful; an effect on citation is unproven.
surface_summary.action: Keep formatting claims separate from outcome claims.

surface_summary.evidence_judgment: Typed evidence, provenance, quality gates, and run manifests align with governance research.
surface_summary.action: Treat engineering tests as contract evidence only.

surface_summary.evidence_judgment: Observational and benchmark evidence can shape hypotheses, not a universal playbook.
surface_summary.action: Keep non-runnable until confirmation and evidence policy review.

surface_summary.evidence_judgment: RAG and conflict research supports provenance and conflict handling.
surface_summary.action: Plan source lineage, conflict records, freshness, and rights metadata before activation.

surface_summary.evidence_judgment: Publication outcome evidence is platform-dependent and frequently proprietary.
surface_summary.action: Keep non-runnable; require reversible actions and explicit authority.

surface_summary.evidence_judgment: Repeated trials, distributions, intervention labels, missing-answer accounting, and platform drift are essential.
surface_summary.action: Aggregate supplied observations only; record trial_count, eligible_trial_count, answered_count, missing_answer_count, missing_answer_reason, numerator, denominator, inclusion_criteria, exclusion_criteria, interval_lower, interval_upper, and interval_method; keep causal_status descriptive.

surface_summary.evidence_judgment: Conventional SEO metrics and operations remain separate; Discover retains offline query and keyword variant generation as a planning function.
surface_summary.action: Exclude search volume, keyword difficulty, SERP rank, traffic attribution, indexation, Core Web Vitals, internal-link operations, and Search Console. Retain query and keyword variants without volume, difficulty, or ranking inference.

conflicts.detail: The quick report lists earlier means of influence_score, a constructed answer-participation proxy, while the final report and CSV recomputation yield 0.2713 for ChatGPT, 0.0584 for Google, and 0.0646 for Perplexity.
conflicts.resolution: Use the recomputed proxy means, mark the quick report figures as stale, and do not treat the proxy as an independent ground-truth outcome.

conflicts.detail: P16 analyzes the D01 data family.
conflicts.resolution: Do not count P16 as independent replication of D01.

conflicts.detail: P22 analyzes the CN-GEO data family represented by D02.
conflicts.resolution: Do not count P22 as independent replication of D02.

conflicts.detail: Optimization benchmarks report gains under selected setups alongside weak, negative, or structurally degraded outcomes in other setups.
conflicts.resolution: Keep tactics conditional, preserve source semantics, and require platform-specific evaluation.

conflicts.detail: Visibility and source sets vary by time, engine, interface, query wording, language, and brand stature.
conflicts.resolution: Use repeated distributions and stratified reporting.

conflicts.detail: Publication metadata or cited references contain placeholders and the supporting materials are insufficient for the stated effect claims.
conflicts.resolution: Exclude the effect claims from product guidance pending independent evidence.

conflicts.detail: The pinned source map uses catalog aliases that differ materially from the titles printed in these PDFs.
conflicts.resolution: Use title for the formal PDF title, catalog_title for the exact source-map alias, and url and id for stable source identity.

recommendations.recommendation: Keep all active outputs free of citation, ranking, traffic, conversion, or revenue guarantees.
Preserve evidence-state labels and prevent observational associations from being rendered as causal advice.
Keep strategy, knowledge, and publish non-runnable; constrain confirmed measure execution to explicit offline observations and descriptive results.
Treat engineering tests as contract and regression evidence only.
Exclude unverifiable private outcome claims and weak-provenance papers from core tactic guidance.

Preserve intervention, comparator, engine, interface, language, geography, collected_at, model_version, sample_unit, trial_count, eligible_trial_count, answered_count, missing_answer_count, missing_answer_reason, numerator, denominator, inclusion_criteria, exclusion_criteria, interval_lower, interval_upper, and interval_method in measurement artifacts.
Add explicit null-result and degradation recording to future evaluations.
Add manipulation, prompt-injection, poisoning, and semantic-drift checks to future content evaluation.
Run preregistered, randomized content interventions with repeated platform sampling and human factuality review.
Create a longitudinal, timestamped CN benchmark with stable run boundaries and platform metadata.

sources.title: Caption Injection for Optimization in Generative Search Engine
sources.catalog_title: Caption Injection for Optimization in Generative Search Engines
sources.study_design: Multimodal ranking benchmark with 4,800 image-text pairs and caption interventions.
sources.finding: A small multimodal gain appears in one condition, while unimodal and several baseline conditions are negative.
sources.license: Paper rights remain with authors and publisher; catalog metadata is attributed under CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: E-GEO: A Testbed for Generative Engine Optimization in E-Commerce
sources.catalog_title: E-GEO: A Testbed for Generative Engine Optimization in E-Commerce
sources.study_design: E-commerce testbed using 7,151 Reddit queries, 52,165 Amazon products, and fifteen rewrite heuristics.
sources.finding: Most heuristics have small, absent, or negative effects; optimized prompts yield a modest best-case gain.
sources.license: Paper rights remain with authors and publisher; catalog metadata is attributed under CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: Multimodal Generative Engine Optimization: Rank Manipulation for Vision-Language Model Rankers
sources.catalog_title: Multimodal Generative Engine Optimization: Rank Manipulation for Vision-Language Model Rankers
sources.study_design: Joint image and text rank manipulation on product datasets using one vision-language model family.
sources.finding: Subtle multimodal edits can change ranks in the tested vision-language ranking setup.
sources.license: Paper rights remain with authors and publisher; catalog metadata is attributed under CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: Generative Engine Optimization: A VLM and Agent Framework for Pinterest Acquisition Growth
sources.catalog_title: Generative Engine Optimization: A VLM and Agent Framework for Pinterest Acquisition Growth
sources.study_design: Proprietary VLM and agent framework with offline, human, and production outcome reporting.
sources.finding: Reports large acquisition outcomes from a Pinterest deployment, with underlying logs and attribution unavailable.
sources.license: Paper rights remain with authors and publisher; catalog metadata is attributed under CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: When Content is Goliath and Algorithm is David: The Style and Semantic Effects of Generative Search Engine
sources.catalog_title: When Content is Goliath and Algorithm is David: The Style and Semantic Effects of Generative Search Engine
sources.study_design: Large website observation, controlled RAG tests, and a randomized human content experiment.
sources.finding: Style and semantic presentation affect selection and human preference under tested conditions, with algorithms and content interacting.
limitations: Human preference does not equal live citation
sources.license: Paper rights remain with authors and publisher; catalog metadata is attributed under CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: Decoupling Search from Reasoning: A Vendor-Agnostic Grounding Architecture for LLM Agents
sources.catalog_title: Decoupling Search from Reasoning: A Vendor-Agnostic Grounding Architecture for LLM Agents
sources.study_design: Five-model grounding benchmark across SimpleQA, FreshQA, HotpotQA, and a proprietary query set.
sources.finding: A decoupled search contract can approach native-search accuracy with lower search cost in selected benchmarks.
limitations: Cost results depend on vendor pricing and latency
sources.license: Paper rights remain with authors and publisher; catalog metadata is attributed under CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: Beyond Parallel Sampling: Diverse Query Initialization for Agentic Search
sources.catalog_title: Beyond Parallel Sampling: Diverse Query Initialization for Agentic Search
sources.study_design: Five open models across eight agentic-search benchmarks with diverse query initialization and three random seeds.
sources.finding: Query diversity improves parallel search for capable models, with limited gains below a model-capacity floor.
sources.license: Paper rights remain with authors and publisher; catalog metadata is attributed under CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: ScholarQuest: A Taxonomy-Guided Benchmark for Agentic Academic Paper Search in Open Literature Environments
sources.catalog_title: ScholarQuest: A Taxonomy-Guided Benchmark for Agentic Academic Paper Search in Open Literature Environments
sources.study_design: One thousand computer-science topics in an arXiv environment comparing taxonomy-guided agentic search with single-shot search.
sources.finding: Agentic search improves selected discovery measures, while efficiency and constraint robustness remain weak.
sources.license: Paper rights remain with authors and publisher; catalog metadata is attributed under CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: When Does Streaming Tool Use Help? Characterizing Tool-Intent Stabilization in Streaming Retrieval-Augmented Generation
sources.catalog_title: When Does Streaming Tool Use Help? Characterizing Tool-Intent Stabilization in Streaming Retrieval-Augmented Generation
sources.study_design: Deterministic BM25 prefix analysis of 1,371 CRAG validation questions plus a sixty-question streaming harness.
sources.finding: Early tool calls help mainly when retrieval intent stabilizes before input completion; benefits collapse for late decisive terms.
limitations: Only 21.3 percent of questions were strictly answer-groundable
sources.license: Paper rights remain with authors and publisher; catalog metadata is attributed under CC BY 4.0.

sources.catalog_title: MCompassRAG: Topic Metadata as a Semantic Compass for Paragraph-Level Retrieval
sources.study_design: Topic-metadata selection and teacher-student retrieval evaluated on paragraph-level retrieval datasets.
sources.finding: Corpus-derived topic metadata can improve paragraph retrieval while moving expensive processing offline.
sources.license: Paper rights remain with authors and publisher; catalog metadata is attributed under CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: SCAR: Semantic Continuity-Aware Retrieval for Efficient Context Expansion in RAG
sources.catalog_title: SCAR: Semantic Continuity-Aware Retrieval for Efficient Context Expansion in RAG
sources.study_design: Semantic continuity-aware adjacent-chunk expansion across boundary-fragmented and natural retrieval datasets.
sources.finding: Query-conditioned expansion improves recall-token efficiency under tested chunk-boundary conditions.
limitations: Adjacent chunks must retain semantic continuity
Retrieval metric does not establish answer quality
sources.license: Paper rights remain with authors and publisher; catalog metadata is attributed under CC BY 4.0.

sources.catalog_title: SproutRAG: Attention-Guided Tree Search with Progressive Embeddings for Long-Document RAG
sources.study_design: Attention-guided hierarchical tree search with progressive embeddings over four long-document benchmarks and three runs.
sources.finding: Progressive hierarchy improves selected retrieval and question-answering measures in long documents.
sources.license: Paper rights remain with authors and publisher; catalog metadata is attributed under CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: Scaling Search Relevance: Augmenting App Store Ranking with LLM-Generated Judgments
sources.catalog_title: Scaling Search Relevance: Augmenting App Store Ranking with LLM-Generated Judgments

sources.catalog_title: SAGE: Scalable AI Governance & Evaluation
